title: Sudocode golden test: expected result of running one program
description: Format in docs/TEST-PLAN.md section 4. Conventions for positions and codes: packages/core/tests/harvested/README.md.

spec.description: Spec rows this program proves (docs/language-spec/), or resolved question IDs such as Q-EDX-4. Empty only for MISC tests.

inputs.description: Lines typed at the keyboard, in order, without newlines.

seed.description: Random seed for the run (SH-12). For Python it is the value passed to random.seed() before the program starts.

files.description: Virtual files that exist before the run: name -> contents.

stdout.description: Everything printed, exactly. Input prompts appear without a newline and typed text is not echoed.

errors.description: Every error, ordered by line then column. Checker errors mean the program never runs (stdout is empty).

warnings.description: Every warning, ordered by line then column.

info.description: Info notes (for example EDX-27, EDX-63), ordered by line then column. Omitted means none.

files.description: Virtual files after the run (name -> contents), or null when the test does not check files.

trace.description: Trace table rows (SH-17) in order, or null when the test does not check the trace. An assignment row names the variable and its value as the debugger shows it (a changed array element records the whole array); an output row holds the printed line without its newline.

openQuestions.description: Questions in docs/review/QUESTIONS.md this expected answer depends on. The test stays pending until they are answered.

notes.description: Why the expected answer is what it is, for the reviewer.

code.description: E- error, W- warning, I- info. Python exceptions are E-PY-<ExceptionName>.

message.description: Exact wording the student reads (tests/errors/ programs give it; elsewhere it is left out).

hint.description: Exact hint wording (tests/errors/ programs give it; elsewhere it is left out).

fix.description: Label of the one-click fix the diagnostic offers (SH-15), where it has one.
